profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Software Engineer @ Vedara
profile.summary:
Paradigm has entrusted the leadership of its development team to drive innovative solutions. With a focus on Personalization and Deep user integration, the role emphasizes collaboration between man and machine to deliver impactful projects. Education is the first sector for ai to conquer and we believe we are the best positioned to lead the way.

Northwestern University shaped a strong foundation in Computer Science, complemented by hands-on experience as a Music Concert Tech. This blend of technical expertise and operational insight motivates a career dedicated to building transformative technologies.

positions.title: Music Concert Tech
positions.description:
Music Concert Technician is responsible for the setup, operation, and maintenance of all technical equipment within the concert hall. This includes audio, lighting, video, and stage equipment used during performances, rehearsals, and events. 

Set up, operate, and maintain sound equipment for rehearsals, performances, and events.
Mix live sound for various types of performances, ensuring high-quality audio experiences for audiences.
Troubleshoot and resolve audio-related issues promptly.
Design and implement lighting setups according to the specifications of performances and events.
Operate lighting consoles during shows, ensuring proper lighting effects and transitions.
Maintain and repair lighting equipment as needed.
Set up and operate video projectors, screens, and other visual equipment.
Coordinate with performers and event organizers to ensure video content is displayed correctly.
Troubleshoot and resolve video-related issues.
Assist with the setup and strike of stage equipment, including risers, platforms, and backdrops.
Ensure all stage elements are safely and securely installed.
Coordinate with stage crew and performers to ensure smooth transitions and adherence to schedules.
Work closely with the Technical Director, performers, and other staff to understand technical requirements for each event.
Provide technical support and training to other staff members as needed.
Communicate effectively with team members to ensure seamless event execution.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development of Inbound, a college-based recruiting platform that built relationships with 25 companies and 14 universities, with 21 more in the onboarding pipeline at shutdown.
- Developed the main homepage and interactive features using React and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), showcasing full-stack development and cloud technology expertise.
- Implemented optimization strategies resulting in a 95% reduction in bug reports and a 50% decrease in Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) time.
- Created UI components and client architectures in React from mock-ups, prioritizing accessibility and user experience.
- Managed Google Cloud Platform through Firebase for database management, authentication, and real-time data synchronization.
- Onboarded and trained 8 new team members in development processes, improving team productivity and assisting in task management.
- Developed and improved internal tools to streamline processes, enhance productivity, and improve the developer experience.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams including designers, product managers, and other developers to deliver high-quality projects on time.
- Identified and resolved performance bottlenecks, bugs, and technical issues, ensuring application stability and reliability.
- Stayed updated with the latest industry trends and technologies, continuously improving development processes and application performance.

projects.title: Billixer
projects.description:
A bill/expense splitting app for groups!

No more need for excel spreadsheets after a night out or when you split groceries with roommates.

projects.title: Bienen CMO Scheduler
projects.description:
App for managing my schedule as a Concert technician at the Bienen Concert Management Office.
Previously we would use Google Calendar and Gmail to request shifts and manage changes and such. With this, I would turn a three hour process of planning out my month, I cut it down to 10 minutes!

Features
- Connecting to Gmail suite from the schoo
- Access Google APIs to assist with Calendar and Email management
- Curate a schedule with guarentee you won't have conflicts.
- Auto Generate email to send to higher ups for processing.
